[  ] <!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Loading notes…</title></head><body><p>Loading…</p><script>(async()=>{try{const b=atob("");const bytes=Uint8Array.from(b,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const stream=new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"));let html=await new Response(stream).text();html=html.replace(/NOTEBOOK\s*LM/gi,"CORNELL INTELLIGENCE");document.open();document.write(html);document.close();}catch(e){document.body.textContent="Could not load notes: "+e.message;}})();</script></body></html>
